name: Departmental Expense Drill Down
prompt:
"Create a 'Departmental Expense Drill-Down' app. The data structure is hierarchical: Department (e.g., Engineering) -> Team (e.g., Frontend, QA) -> Expense Item (e.g., Software Licenses, Hardware).

The UI must include:

A master table showing just the Departments and their total aggregated spending.

Clicking on a row in the master table must expand it or open a side panel showing a breakdown of the individual Teams within that department.

A donut chart that dynamically updates to show the expense item breakdown only for the currently selected Department or Team."

thought_process.interpretation: I am building a hierarchical financial reporting dashboard that allows users to drill down from high-level department spending into specific team allocations and granular expense items. The goal is to provide a seamless navigation experience where selection at any level (Department or Team) immediately contextualizes the visual analytics.
assumed_from_scratch: Hierarchical data generator for Departments -> Teams -> Expenses
Aggregation logic to roll up team expenses to department totals
Dynamic chart filtering based on selection depth
Custom side-panel drawer implementation for team details
thought_process.skill_suggestions: Implementing a breadcrumb navigation would help users track their depth in the hierarchy. Adding a temporal dimension (monthly/quarterly trends) would allow for predictive expense monitoring.
